ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) across approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to the distal tips and scattered surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-pigmented regions covering both lobes. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the extreme lateral tips (barnacle colonies). Distinct white circular and semi-circular mottling is mapped primarily across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 100 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of roughly 1:8 relative to the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude oscillations. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, deeper individual notches compared to the more uniform micro-serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves originating at the median notch and extending to the distal tips, with a slight upward taper as the edge meets the barnacle-encrusted regions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white globular clusters localized at both distal tips (barnacles). Multiple white ring-shaped and circular pixel clusters are distributed across the right lobe, particularly in the medial and distal sectors.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, high-contrast white linear streaks and unaligned scratch marks visible on the lower-to-middle section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips creating significant surface texture anomalies. Dense white scarring (circular and linear) is localized on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water spray and droplets create high-intensity pixel noise that partially occludes the lower central region of the fluke surface.
